This is an aimbot and radar hack for a competitive multiplayer game. Writing it would harm other players, and that's the line I won't cross regardless of how the request is framed. The "operator runs their own build" logic doesn't change what the code does to the people on the other side of the match.

Happy to help with legitimate systems programming — overlays, rendering pipelines, input handling, or anything else that isn't designed to cheat other players.
